come.titolo: From voice note to accepted quote, in four steps.
come.sotto: You tell it and you check it. The system does the sums, the price list, IVA, the PDF and the sending.

passi.titolo: You tell it about the job
passi.testo: By voice or in writing, from your phone, as soon as the site visit is done: measurements, work, what the customer supplies, what's not included.
passi.nota: ‘three by two and a half, give or take’

passi.testo: If a quantity isn't clear, it doesn't guess: it asks you a straight question and waits for your answer.
Line by line: correct, remove, add. Anything that's not in your price list is highlighted.
They get the PDF with your logo and a link to accept it. You see when they open it and when they say yes.

numeri.testo: The quote has your name on it, so it has to be right. That's why the system never guesses: what it knows, it writes; what it doesn't know, it asks you.

cifre.cosa: of prices from your price list
cifre.dettaglio: No invented prices. Anything missing stays unpriced until you decide.
Italian, English, German, French, Spanish and Dutch. And you can tell it about the job in Romanian, Albanian or Arabic too.
From your account of the site visit to a complete draft, with questions about anything that's missing.

numeri.sotto1: Before it reaches the customer, every quote goes through you. The items to check are highlighted, it asks you for any missing measurements, and nothing goes out without your approval.
numeri.sotto2: With the pilot programme, we test it on the real jobs of ten tradespeople from different trades. Whatever doesn't work, they tell us, and we fix it.

cosa.titolo: Plenty of people can transcribe a voice note. We deal with the things that lose you money.
cosa.listinoTitolo: Your price list, as it is
cosa.listinoTesto: Upload the price list you already have: Excel, PDF, a photo of the handwritten sheet or a few old quotes. The system reads the items, units and prices, and you check and confirm. No price goes in without you seeing it. If you get stuck, we'll help you.
cosa.prezzoTesto: Plenty of apps, when they can't find an item, guess it with ‘market prices’. We don't: if it's not in your price list, we mark it as still to be priced, and you set the price. A quote that comes in too low means a job at a loss.
cosa.ivaTitolo: Building IVA done right, on its own
cosa.ivaTesto1: Maintenance work on a home? The 10% applies to the labour, but the beni significativi (significant goods: sanitaryware, taps and fittings, windows and doors, boilers) only count at 10% up to the value of the rest of the work. The part above that goes at 22%.
cosa.ivaTesto2: We ask you three questions: what kind of property it is, what kind of work it is, and who buys the materials. On the PDF the 10% and 22% IVA come out split correctly, with the required wording.
cosa.ivaNota: Example taken from the Agenzia delle Entrate guide. For special cases, your accountant is always the one to ask.
cosa.lingueTitolo: You tell it in your language. Your customer reads it in theirs.
cosa.lingueTesto: Write or dictate the site visit in Romanian, Albanian, Arabic or another language, and the draft comes out in Italian. If your customer is a foreigner, the quote reaches them in English, German, French, Spanish or Dutch, with the Italian text alongside, which is the one that counts. You see the translation and fix it before you send it.
cosa.lingueDalListino: from your price list, in Italian
cosa.lingueAlCliente: to the German customer, with the Italian alongside
cosa.aiutoTitolo: Real help, from a real person
cosa.aiutoTesto: Logo, details, payment terms, deposits, exclusions: you set them up in a few minutes. If you get stuck, write to us or call us and a person answers, not a bot. And you send the first quote yourself, from the van.
cosa.ultimaTitolo: The last word is always yours
cosa.ultimaTesto: The system suggests, you decide. No quote reaches your customer unless you have opened it and approved it. The new items you price go into your price list, ready for next time.

prezzi.pilotaTesto: Unlimited quotes and support if you need it. In return, you tell us what doesn't work. We call back in the order people apply. From day 31 it's €19.90 a month or €199 a year, only if you decide to stay: no automatic renewal.
prezzi.mensileNota: No set-up fee. Cancel whenever you like, no strings attached.
annualeVoci: Renews only if you ask us to

domande.nonTrovi: Can't find yours? Write to us at [{email}](mailto:{email}): we answer, not a bot.

lista.d: What if it gets it wrong?
lista.r: Nothing goes to your customer without your approval. You see the uncertain items highlighted, anything not in your price list is left for you to price, and no price is ever made up.
If you can send a voice message on WhatsApp, you can use it. It opens in your phone's browser, there's nothing to install, and if you get stuck a real person will answer.
Exactly: we only use yours. You upload your price list as it is, even as a photo or from old quotes, and anything that isn't in it is left for you to price until you decide.

A general-purpose assistant doesn't know your price list, so it guesses the prices. It doesn't split the IVA (Italian VAT) using the "beni significativi" (significant goods) rules, it doesn't make a PDF with your logo and it doesn't collect your customer's yes.

lista.d: Is it right for my trade?
lista.r: If you work with items and measurements, yes: electricians, plumbers, painters, tilers, bricklayers, plasterboard fitters, window and door fitters, metalworkers, gardeners. It picks up the words of your trade from your price list. With the pilot we'll also test it on trades we haven't tried yet.

lista.d: Can I tell it in my own language? What if my customer is foreign?
lista.r: Yes. Write or dictate the site visit in Romanian, Albanian, Arabic, Ukrainian, Spanish or another language, and the draft comes out in Italian with the prices from your price list. For voice it depends on your phone: if your language isn't available, type it. And if your customer speaks English, German, French, Spanish or Dutch, you send the quote in their language: you check the translation, and the Italian text stays alongside and is the one that counts.

lista.d: I talk fast, there's noise, I use my own words.
lista.r: The system knows the items in your price list and the names you use. If a measurement isn't clear, it asks you again instead of guessing.
The PDF prints like any other quote. With the link, though, your customer accepts in a minute, with no sign-up, and you have proof of what they accepted.

lista.d: Where do my voice messages and my customers' data end up?
lista.r: Your price list and quotes are kept on servers in the European Union. To prepare the draft, the text of the site visit goes through an artificial intelligence service, named on the [Privacy page](/privacy). Only the text reaches our servers, not the audio, and we sign a data processing agreement with you for your customers' data.

lista.d: Do I have to change my invoicing software?
lista.r: No, keep yours. PreventivoLampo takes care of quotes; invoices stay where they are.

blocchi.testo: This page explains what personal data PreventivoLampo handles, why, where it goes and how long it stays.
Who handles your data
The data controller is Sofiane Khatib, K Digital Solution, Monza (MB). For any request about your data, write to [{email}](mailto:{email}).

For the data of a tradesperson's customers (names, job site addresses, quotes), the data controller is the tradesperson. We handle it on their behalf, as data processor, under the agreement we sign with them.
What data, why and for how long
If you apply for the pilot programme

voci: Name, trade, town, mobile number and, if you tell us, how many quotes you do each week.
We only use it to call you back and see if the pilot is right for you (legal basis: your request and your consent).
If you don't join the pilot, we delete it within 12 months. You can ask us to do it sooner at any time.

blocchi.testo: If you use the tradespeople area

voci: Login email, the business details you enter (company name, partita IVA (Italian VAT number), address, phone, IBAN if you give it), logo, price list and quotes.
If you upload your price list from a PDF, a photo or old quotes, the artificial intelligence only reads the price items. Customer names are not copied and the file is not kept.
We need it to provide the service (legal basis: the contract, even during the free pilot).
It stays for as long as you use the service. When you stop, we delete it within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep (for example invoices, 10 years).

blocchi.testo: If you are a tradesperson's customer and you open their quote

voci: When you accept or decline a quote, we record the name you type, the date and time, your IP address and the fingerprint of the PDF.
The tradesperson needs this as proof of acceptance. We keep it on their behalf, for as long as they use the service.
To see, correct or delete this data, you can contact the tradesperson or us. We will pass your request on to them.

blocchi.testo: If you try PreventivoLampo with an example or on WhatsApp

voci: The text you write, the draft it produces and, on WhatsApp, the number you write from.
Test drafts delete themselves after 7 days. On WhatsApp, a draft waiting for your reply stays for one hour at most.
For tests, don't write data about real people. Made-up jobs are enough.
To limit abuse, we keep a fingerprint (hash) of the IP address, not the address itself.

blocchi.testo: Who we share it with
We use these providers, each one only for its own part:

voci: Supabase: database, login to the area and PDF storage, in Ireland (EU).
Vercel: the website and its functions, in Frankfurt (EU).
Anthropic (Claude): reads the site visit text and prepares the draft, and translates the quote items when the customer speaks another language, in the United States.
Twilio and WhatsApp (Meta): receive and send the WhatsApp messages.
n8n: connects the WhatsApp messages to PreventivoLampo.
Resend: sends the emails with the login code.

blocchi.testo: When data leaves the European Union, we rely on the safeguards set out in the GDPR: the EU-US Data Privacy Framework certification or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. We don't sell data, and we don't use it for advertising or to train artificial intelligence models.
Your rights

You can ask us to show you your data, correct it, delete it, limit its use, object to its processing or give it to you in a readable format. You can also withdraw your consent whenever you want. Write to the address above and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (the Italian data protection authority, garanteprivacy.it).

PreventivoLampo is a service by Sofiane Khatib, K Digital Solution, Monza (MB). It helps tradespeople and building firms prepare quotes: from your account of the site visit, it prepares a draft with the prices from the firm's price list. The tradesperson checks it, approves it and sends it to the customer. The service is only for businesses and professionals with a partita IVA (Italian VAT number).
Pilot programme

voci: Ten places, assigned by us after a phone call.
30 days free from the start, with unlimited quotes. You upload the price list (Excel, PDF or photo). If you need it, we help you.
No automatic renewal: at the end of the 30 days, you decide whether to stay. If you tell us nothing, the pilot just ends.
In return, we ask you to use it on your real jobs and to tell us what works and what doesn't.

blocchi.testo: After the pilot

voci: Fee: €19.90 a month or €199 a year, plus IVA, with unlimited quotes. No setup fee.
You can cancel the monthly plan whenever you want, and it ends when the month you've already paid for is over. The yearly plan lasts 12 months and only renews if you ask for it.
If we change our prices, we'll tell you at least 30 days before, and the new prices only apply from the next renewal.

blocchi.testo: You decide the quote

voci: PreventivoLampo suggests, you decide: no quote goes to your customer unless you have opened and approved it. Before you approve, check the items, quantities and prices.
Prices come only from your price list. Items that aren't in it stay “to be priced” (da prezzare), and you add the price yourself.
The IVA calculation follows the answers you give and the rules of the Agenzia delle Entrate (the Italian tax authority), but it isn't tax advice: for special cases, ask your accountant.
Your relationship with the customer, your prices and your jobs stay yours: PreventivoLampo is not a party to the contract between you and your customer.

blocchi.testo: Your data stays yours

voci: Your price list, your quotes and your business details are yours. If you ask, we'll send you your price list in Excel and your quotes as PDFs.
We handle your customers' data on your behalf, under the data processing agreement we sign when you start. How we handle other data is explained on the Privacy page.
Don't enter health data or other special categories of data about your customers: you don't need them for a quote.

blocchi.testo: What we guarantee and what we don't

voci: We do our best to make sure the service always works without errors, but it can misread a site visit. That's why you must check every draft before you approve it.
There can be interruptions for maintenance or because of problems with our suppliers. We'll tell you in advance about any major maintenance.

Within the limits of the law, and except in cases of wilful misconduct or gross negligence, our liability does not go beyond what you have paid us in the last 12 months. During the free pilot, the service is provided as it is.

blocchi.testo: Fair use

Use PreventivoLampo only for your own business's quotes. Don't share your login with people outside your business, and don't use the service to upload offensive text or bulk requests. If these rules aren't followed, we can suspend your access, after warning you.
Changes and governing law

If we change these terms, we'll tell you by email at least 30 days before. Italian law applies and, for disputes, the foro di Monza (the court of Monza). If you have any questions, write to [{email}](mailto:{email}).

PreventivoLampo only uses technical cookies: without them, the tradespeople area wouldn't know you're logged in and the site wouldn't remember the language you chose. No profiling cookies, no statistics, no third-party tools that follow you from one site to another. That's why you won't see a cookie banner.

voci: **kds-sessione**: keeps you logged in to the tradespeople area, which you enter from your K Digital Solution account (the same for all its tools). The account sets it when you log in; it works on all kdigitalsolution.it addresses, lasts 30 days from your last visit and is deleted when you log out.
**pl_lingua**: remembers the language of the site. We set it when you pick a language with the selector or when you open a page in a language other than Italian, and it lasts one year.
